compiler_versions.clang:
Ubuntu clang version 18.1.3 (1ubuntu1)
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin

clippy: cargo clippy --offline -p toucan_bindings --test incomplete_record_names -- -D warnings passed
collision_policy: Retain the existing qualified opaque name when an unrelated ordinary typedef uses the unqualified name. Both collision outputs remain byte-identical to baseline; pinned bindgen output fails Rust with duplicate types.
prototype_policy: A tag introduced in a callback prototype is separate from the later file-scope tag. GCC and Clang reject assigning the file-scope callback, and Toucan preserves distinct Rust types.
limits: This is a native Linux x86-64 naming and compile study, not another target or complete API equality.
The full AWS-LC consumer was not rebuilt. Its generation was replayed with the untouched pinned sys_bindgen module; the baseline exactly reproduces the archived all-bindings output.
Incomplete records retain private zero-length pointer-only representation. No C sizeof or by-value ABI is claimed; GCC and Clang reject sizeof on the incomplete control.
No comparator normalization or generated layout policy changed.

The initial AWS replay enabled a prelude omitted by the actual upstream build. Its driver, outputs and diff are preserved separately; the corrected replay sets the exact upstream disable_prelude=true option.
One initial offline Cargo attempt used the default registry configuration and could not resolve serde. The focused tests and Clippy passed with the established cache Cargo home.
